theme_strategy: Light mode primary. Farming is an outdoor, high-glare activity. A dark theme will reflect too much glare on standard smartphones in the field. The aesthetic is Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Trust, Growth, Calm) to convey a natural, agricultural, and highly accessible feel.

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-stone-900 leading-tight

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders (border-stone-200) for all cards to prevent visual clutter. No glassmorphism here; it needs to look deeply functional and tactile.

component_rules.buttons: Buttons MUST be oversized for easy tapping. Minimum height `h-14` or `h-16`. Use `rounded-xl`. The 'Speak' button should be visually dominant (e.g., massive circular or full-width pill button).
component_rules.cards: Use Shadcn Card component. Remove the default border if using shadow, or use 1px border with no shadow. Internal padding must be generous (`p-6` or `p-8`).
component_rules.inputs: Use standard HTML/Tailwind input logic for basic text, but Shadcn Select for dropdowns. Inputs must be `h-14` for easy selection.
component_rules.bottom_navigation: A fixed bottom navigation bar (`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-stone-200 shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] z-50 h-20`) with 4-5 core tabs. Icons must be large with text labels.

layouts.global: Mobile-first PWA. On desktop, constrain the main app view to a max-width (e.g., `max-w-md mx-auto bg-white min-h-screen shadow-xl`) to maintain the mobile app feel, or use a responsive sidebar, but mobile layout is the absolute priority.
layouts.home_screen: Focus on the tagline: 'Speak. Type. Show.' Use a massive grid (1 column on mobile) where the three primary input methods are huge, tactile cards.
layouts.farm_assessment_dashboard: DO NOT render as a generic chat paragraph. Render as a structured Bento-style dashboard: Overall Status (Color-coded: Red/Yellow/Green), Primary Concern, Factors Considered, Next Steps (Actionable checklist).
layouts.multi_agent_visualization: Display a dynamic grid or list showing agents (Crop Agent, Weather Agent, Soil Agent) 'working' with status indicators (e.g., 'Analyzing...', 'Done').

motion.interactions: Keep it tactile and physical. On press/active, buttons should scale down slightly (`active:scale-95 transition-transform`). Avoid complex page transitions; prioritize immediate feedback.
motion.loading: Use simple skeleton loaders or a pulsating green icon. The 'AI Agents Working' view should have sequential fade-ins to show thought processes.

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for ALL interactive elements. Primary actions should be 64px+.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure absolute high contrast. Text must be `stone-900` or `stone-800` on white/light gray.
accessibility.language_controls: Include a highly visible 'Read Aloud' (Speaker icon) toggle near text blocks for low-literacy users. Multi-language toggle (EN/HI/TA/TE) must be prominent in the header.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="speak-button"`).

farmer_profile.description: Farmer using smartphone in field, useful for onboarding or profile placeholder.

healthy_crops.description: Lush green crops, use for 'My Farm' header or background accents.

soil_health.description: Hands holding rich soil and a small plant. Good for 'Soil Agent' or 'Farm Guide' thumbnails.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application as a Mobile-First PWA. The layout should look and feel like a native mobile app, complete with a fixed Bottom Navigation Bar.
Implement the 'Home' screen to immediately offer 'Speak Your Problem', 'Type Your Problem', and 'Show Your Crop' as massive, distinct actions.

When building the 'AI Farm Assessment', completely avoid standard chatbot UIs. Instead, render a clean Dashboard with discrete sections: Status Alert, Action Plan (Today / Next 3 Days), and 'Why This Recommendation' (accordion/expandable).
Integrate a 'Listen' button next to major text blocks to simulate the audio accessibility requirement.
Include the multi-agent AI visualization block showing 'Crop Agent', 'Weather Agent', etc., resolving data before presenting the final assessment.
Use Lucide-react for all iconography. Ensure icons are paired with clear text labels.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects sparingly; for this specific app, prefer solid accessible backgrounds but utilize subtle soft shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. For this app, use large, rounded-xl accessible buttons.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, press scales, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text/domains.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
